articles.title: Russian Airstrike Kills 18 in Komyshuvakha Ukraine Humanitarian Center
articles.description: Russian forces struck a humanitarian aid center in Komyshuvakha, killing at least 18 people including emergency responders. President Zelenskyy condemned the attack following the Oleshky evacuation truce.

articles.title: Dozens Killed in Airstrike Near Zaporizhzhia
articles.description: According to the latest official figures from civil defense authorities, at least 24 people were killed in a Russian airstrike on the Ukrainian village of Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region. This occurred while humanitarian aid was being distributed at a school, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported on Telegram and on the X platform. At least five people were injured. Searches are underway in the rubble for additional victims. Twenty-seven people were reported missing, according to regional military administrator Mykhailo Semikin on Telegram.
